headline: Viper Pit Erupts Overnight; Godcrofts Swept by Colonials
war_summary: Since our last edition the Viper Pit has broken into sudden fury: more than a thousand Colonial and six hundred Warden fallen in barely two hours, hourly counts still climbing, yet not one of its posts has changed hands. Callahan's Passage remains the war's costliest grind, some thirteen thousand eight hundred casualties there in the past day, The Latch eight times contested and flags shifting about it through the night. Weathered Expanse keeps its crown as busiest ground with fifty-three actions in twenty-four hours about Wightwalk and Spirit Watch, its one ruined work since reclaimed; Stlican Shelf runs a close second and The Pale House alone took twenty-four blows, while Fisherman's Row now counts a work in ruin. Linn of Mercy bleeds hot about The First Coin, and Farranac Coast's casualty lines climb without a flag stirring. Godcrofts, wholly Colonial since its last Warden post fell, has gone quiet, as have the Dead Lands these six hours past. The ledger reads 284 works Colonial, 150 Warden, two in ruin; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize and no victor is named.
